projects.practical_disposition: Phase 1 remains preserved with final result APPROVED_SPACE_EXHAUSTED / RESEARCH_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED. Phase 2 routes 1 and 2 remain terminally implementation-inconclusive with no economic result, and route 3 remains terminally methodology-inconclusive with no economic result. Route 4's final authorized live read-only Sol/xhigh narrow provenance delta review returned substantive REVISION_REQUIRED. The non-circular draft/schema binding passed check 1, but the network-attempt schema failed check 8 and immutable terminal reconstruction failed check 9; the bounded delta also invalidated prior check 4. Reproducible counterexamples include acceptance of SUCCESS_HTTP with status 503, undetected deletion of a complete final logical-request suffix or the whole ledger, unresolved pagination lineage, unverified retained-blob references, incomplete post-response-start transport outcomes, and superseded raw-index references in the effective draft. Under the explicit hard-stop rule, no retry, further Route 4 correction, sixth direction review, freeze manifest, implementation, or acquisition is authorized. Route 4 is administratively terminal for the current authorization but is not scientifically or economically consumed. This is not DATA_NO_GO, HISTORICAL_NO_GO, a strategy result, or evidence of profitability or unprofitability. No Route 4 network request, archive object discovery or download, market-data access, strategy implementation, model training, backtest, return calculation, acquisition attempt, or holdout-path access occurred. Controller tests and contract checks are not evidence of trading profitability. Every Phase 2 final holdout remains sealed, unopened, and unread; no candidate is promoted; capital and GPU permission remain zero; Vertcoin mining is unchanged. A program-level human decision is required before any independent next route.
